evidence: Carries the Tests label and updates both test vector generation and the script_assets_test runner schema/verification to validate specific script errors.
rationale: Fixes misleading consensus test cases in shared test vectors that could pass for the wrong failure reason. The author observed that 'running script_assets_test.json against a third-party implementation which executed OP_CHECKMULTISIG in tapscript and passed every case' demonstrated the test vector failed to catch invalid opcode execution.
